headline: Exchange Inflows Fall To 1,072.0 Million Dollars From 1,324.5 Million
narrative: The 24-hour exchange inflow fell to 1,072.0 million dollars, 0.3954 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, from 1,324.5 million dollars at 0.4875 percent. Binance took in 1,142.7 million dollars, while Bitstamp shed 164.7 million dollars and Bitget shed 74.7 million dollars. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means money arrived where holders can sell, and the Bitstamp and Bitget prints are money leaving those venues.
author: jordan
